items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.content: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.content: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
items.content: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
items.content: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

items.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
items.content: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
items.content: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

items.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
items.content: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
items.content: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

items.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
items.content: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

items.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
items.content: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.

items.title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
items.content: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.

items.title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
items.content: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201 million Monday, with seven straight sessions of net withdrawals from BlackRock’s IBIT totaling $1.66 billion.

items.title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
items.content: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

items.title: Crypto exchanges need hard dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says
items.content: “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” the cybersecurity firm told Cointelegraph.

items.title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds
items.content: Control Room cuts off model output for internal research jobs when people or automated monitors flag safety or security concerns.

items.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
items.content: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

items.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
items.content: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

items.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
items.content: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

items.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
items.content: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
items.content: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

items.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
items.content: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

items.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
items.content: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

items.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
items.content: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

items.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
items.content: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

items.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
items.content: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

items.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
items.content: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

items.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
items.content: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

items.title: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect
items.content: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.
